# Project Remniscence - AR/VR Companion App

This is a Unity-based AR/VR project that creates a gentle companion experience with the character Rem. The project uses:

- Unity 3D with XR Toolkit for AR/VR functionality
- VRM format for 3D character models
- C# scripting for Unity components
- Text-to-Speech (TTS) integration
- GPT API integration for AI interactions
- WebXR capabilities for browser-based experiences

## Development Guidelines

- Follow Unity C# naming conventions (PascalCase for public members, camelCase for private)
- Use Unity's component-based architecture
- Implement proper XR input handling for multiple platforms
- Keep animations smooth and gentle to match the calming theme
- Structure code for modularity between AR and VR modes
- Use Unity's built-in audio system for voice and sound effects
- Implement proper memory management for AR/VR applications

## Key Features to Implement

- Character presence and idle animations
- Voice interaction system
- GPT integration for conversational AI
- Gesture and touch input handling
- Ambient particle effects
- Cross-platform XR compatibility

Please generate Unity-compatible C# scripts and follow Unity project structure conventions.
